firm_data.firm_description: Stonberg, Hickman & Pavloff is a full-service defense litigation and insurance coverage firm serving clients in the State and Federal Courts in New York and New Jersey. They provide high-quality legal representation to their clients on a cost effective basis.
notable_facts: The firm was formerly known as Stonberg Moran.

email.subject: AI for Stonberg, Hickman & Pavloff, built for defense litigation firms
email.body:
Hi Kevin,

Stonberg, Hickman & Pavloff built your practice around cost-effective defense litigation and insurance coverage work in New York and New Jersey courts. That lean, high-output model is exactly what we see working for firms competing with BigLaw.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers built tools that actually work for defense and coverage practices.

Worth 20 minutes to explore this?

Vasu
Lucio
